description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Clue and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
